title: derive(Eq): enum equality comparison
description: Test derive(Eq) on enum with and without payloads
input:
enum Color { Red; Green; Blue } derive(Eq)
enum Shape { Circle(Int); Rect(Int, Int) } derive(Eq)

test "derive eq" {
  assert(eq(Red, Red))
  assert(not(eq(Red, Blue)))
  assert(eq(Circle(5), Circle(5)))
  assert(not(eq(Circle(5), Rect(1, 2))))
}
